category: Localized lighting, depth and bleak atmosphere without hiding geometry
scoring_basis: 100 minus 2 points for the single evidenced minor lighting defect L-C08-001. No threshold-based rounding or overall score.

defects.title: Cargo conveyor lower construction loses tonal separation
defects.asset: Cargo inspection conveyor lower front/side frame and shelf
defects.finding: In both beauty views, the lower black shelf and nearby front/side frame faces compress into a near-black band below the rollers and crate. Neutral reveals these faces more clearly. The crate, tunnel, rollers, legs against the floor and main machine silhouette remain recognizable, so this is a local secondary-construction readability loss, not hidden hero geometry or a critical defect.
defects.direction: Preserve the dark undercarriage, but give its adjacent frame and shelf faces slightly more separated reflected/local fill values.

strengths.finding: Warm hatch/task pools expose working forms while shadowed office recesses provide depth and an oppressive institutional mood.
Cool-lit scanner and platform retain clear silhouette/contact separation through entry, approach and reverse views.
Purposeful darkness keeps storage, roof and gate subordinate while essential panel, restraint, route and cart forms remain readable.
Practical sources show local influence and falloff; amber/status emissions are small functional accents, and contact/cast shadows ground major assemblies.

limitations: This is a still-image category-5 review only; no native contents or renderer code were inspected. Byte hashing does not certify native lighting construction or dependencies.
Four neutral and four UV diagnostics cover selected assets, not every gameplay view. Their altered illumination/materials are comparative evidence, not finished atmosphere.
Corner and wall views deliberately hide enclosure/roof/other geometry; their pixels cannot independently establish enclosed-room atmosphere, and omissions are not defects.
Current manifests report 24 samples and cold_open false. No cold-render agreement, temporal behavior, runtime performance, gameplay interactions or engine exposure is certified.
The approved spawn images benchmark practical-light discipline and readability; their compositions and light levels are not exact dock requirements.
scope_statement: Only the three permitted direction/rubric documents, current manifest/provenance records, actual current/reference pixels and byte-hash provenance were used. No prior scores, reviews, author plans or rationale were read. No source/native/code edit, build, render or save occurred.
